rumors.headline: Dallas and Jason Robertson keep talking long term
rumors.summary: Robertson is in the last year of his deal and headed for unrestricted free agency. The two sides are said to be working on an eight-year framework, with the Stars' cap room the main sticking point.

rumors.headline: Cale Makar extension expected to reset the defenseman market
rumors.summary: Colorado's franchise defenseman can become a UFA next summer. League chatter has the new number landing well above any current blueliner AAV.

rumors.headline: Quinn Hughes in no rush to sign in Minnesota
rumors.summary: Hughes has one year left at $7.85M and no trade protection. He is reportedly happy to play the season out before deciding where he signs long term.

rumors.headline: Pittsburgh open to moving Erik Karlsson before the deadline
rumors.summary: With Karlsson's $11.5M deal expiring, the Penguins are listening on the veteran defenseman. His full no-move clause means he controls where he goes, and retained salary would almost certainly be needed.

rumors.headline: Contenders checking in on Drew Doughty
rumors.summary: Doughty is in the last year of his $11M deal with a modified no-trade clause. Teams looking for a right-shot veteran for a playoff run have called, but the cap hit is a hurdle.

rumors.headline: Dallas could look to clear Tyler Seguin's $9.85M
rumors.summary: Moving Seguin's expiring contract would open room for the Robertson extension. His no-move clause and recent injuries limit the market.

rumors.headline: St. Louis weighing a Jordan Binnington move
rumors.summary: With Joel Hofer pushing for starts, the Blues are said to be open to moving Binnington's expiring $6M deal to a team in need of a veteran starter.

rumors.headline: John Gibson's name surfaces in goalie market talk
rumors.summary: Gibson's $6.4M contract runs out this season and Detroit is evaluating its crease. Goalie-needy contenders are monitoring the situation.

rumors.headline: Huberdeau's contract back in the buyout conversation
rumors.summary: Calgary is carrying a $10.5M cap hit through 2031 for production well below that price. A summer buyout is being discussed as one option to free cap space.

rumors.headline: Anaheim could buy out Frank Vatrano
rumors.summary: Vatrano's $6M hit runs through 2028 while his recent Impact has dipped. A buyout would give the Ducks more room to re-sign their young core.

rumors.headline: San Jose preparing a max-term offer for Macklin Celebrini
rumors.summary: Celebrini's entry-level deal ends this season. The Sharks are expected to push for an eight-year extension as soon as he is eligible.

rumors.headline: Jack Quinn could be an offer sheet target next summer
rumors.summary: Quinn will be a restricted free agent with strong recent Impact. Teams with cap room are said to view him as a realistic offer sheet candidate if Buffalo does not extend him first.

rumors.headline: Kirill Marchenko on the offer sheet radar
rumors.summary: Marchenko heads into restricted free agency off two productive seasons. Toronto's tight cap makes him a name to watch for teams willing to pay the compensation picks.

rumors.headline: Dawson Mercer drawing interest ahead of RFA summer
rumors.summary: Winnipeg is said to be gauging the market for Mercer, who is due a raise as a restricted free agent. A hockey trade for a defenseman is the likeliest path.
